d:
Bihar ke motihari se ek ajibogrib mamla samne aaya hai, jahan ek shakhs apni bhains lekar nyay ki guhar lagane thane pahunch gaya. thane men bhains ke sath pahunche is shakhs ko dekhkar puliskarmi bhi hairan rah gae. aakhir bhains ke sath thane pahunchne ki kya hai vajah aur malik kis bat ko lekar mang raha hai insaph? dekhie yah anokha mamla.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
